honoree_link_shape.name: honoree_link_shape
honoree_link_shape.value: "honoree_link"."id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$' and "honoree_link"."context_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "honoree_link"."token_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "honoree_link"."key_id"='k1' and "honoree_link"."reading_epoch">=0 and "honoree_link"."group_epoch">=0 and "honoree_link"."honors_version">0 and (("honoree_link"."role"='parent' and "honoree_link"."guardian_id" is not null and "honoree_link"."student_identity_id" is null) or ("honoree_link"."role"='admin' and "honoree_link"."guardian_id" is null and "honoree_link"."student_identity_id" is null) or ("honoree_link"."role"='student' and "honoree_link"."guardian_id" is null and "honoree_link"."student_identity_id" is not null))

honoree_link_instants.name: honoree_link_instants
honoree_link_instants.value: isfinite("honoree_link"."issued_at") and isfinite("honoree_link"."expires_at") and "honoree_link"."expires_at">"honoree_link"."issued_at" and "honoree_link"."expires_at"<="honoree_link"."issued_at"+interval '2160 hours' and ("honoree_link"."revoked_at" is null or isfinite("honoree_link"."revoked_at") and "honoree_link"."revoked_at">="honoree_link"."issued_at")

honoree_material_shape.name: honoree_material_shape
honoree_material_shape.value: "honoree_material_release"."state" in ('active','withdrawn') and "honoree_material_release"."slot" in ('morning','havdalah') and "honoree_material_release"."projection_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "honoree_material_release"."catalog_identity" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and length("honoree_material_release"."material_version") between 1 and 128 and octet_length("honoree_material_release"."approval_basis") between 1 and 4096 and isfinite("honoree_material_release"."created_at")

honoree_material_units.name: honoree_material_units
honoree_material_units.value: "honoree_material_release"."before_id"='torah.blessing-before-the-torah-reading@'||case when "honoree_material_release"."slot"='morning' then 'bm-shacharit' else 'bm-maariv' end and "honoree_material_release"."after_id"='torah.blessing-following-the-torah-reading@'||case when "honoree_material_release"."slot"='morning' then 'bm-shacharit' else 'bm-maariv' end

honoree_operation_shape.name: honoree_operation_shape
honoree_operation_shape.value: "honoree_operation"."request_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "honoree_operation"."operation" in ('issue','revoke','reissue') and (("honoree_operation"."role"='parent' and "honoree_operation"."guardian_id" is not null and "honoree_operation"."student_identity_id" is null) or ("honoree_operation"."role"='admin' and "honoree_operation"."guardian_id" is null and "honoree_operation"."student_identity_id" is null) or ("honoree_operation"."role"='student' and "honoree_operation"."guardian_id" is null and "honoree_operation"."student_identity_id" is not null)) and isfinite("honoree_operation"."created_at")

honors_version_versions.name: honors_version_versions
honors_version_versions.value: "honors_version"."version" > 0 and "honors_version"."base_version" >= 0 and "honors_version"."version"::bigint = "honors_version"."base_version"::bigint + 1 and (("honors_version"."base_version"=0 and "honors_version"."previous_version" is null) or ("honors_version"."base_version">0 and "honors_version"."previous_version"="honors_version"."base_version" and "honors_version"."previous_version" is not null))

honors_version_author.name: honors_version_author
honors_version_author.value: "honors_version"."mode"::text="honors_version"."role"::text and (("honors_version"."mode"='parent' and "honors_version"."guardian_id" is not null and "honors_version"."student_identity_id" is null) or ("honors_version"."mode"='admin' and "honors_version"."guardian_id" is null and "honors_version"."student_identity_id" is null) or ("honors_version"."mode"='student' and "honors_version"."guardian_id" is null and "honors_version"."student_identity_id" is not null))

lesson_log_summary.name: lesson_log_summary
lesson_log_summary.value: ("lesson_log"."deleted" and "lesson_log"."summary" = '') or (not "lesson_log"."deleted" and length(trim("lesson_log"."summary")) > 0 and octet_length("lesson_log"."summary") <= 4096)

practice_event_target.name: practice_event_target
practice_event_target.value:
coalesce(jsonb_typeof("practice_event"."target") = 'object' and (
    ("practice_event"."target"->>'type' = 'verse'
      and "practice_event"."target" ?& array['type','kind','assignmentId','assignmentRevision','verseRef']
      and "practice_event"."target" - array['type','kind','assignmentId','assignmentRevision','verseRef']::text[] = '{}'::jsonb
      and "practice_event"."target"->>'kind' in ('torah','haftarah')
      and "practice_event"."target"->>'assignmentId' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$'
      and jsonb_typeof("practice_event"."target"->'assignmentRevision') = 'number' and "practice_event"."target"->>'assignmentRevision' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$' and "practice_event"."target"->'assignmentRevision' <= '2147483647'::jsonb
      and length("practice_event"."target"->>'verseRef') <= 100 and "practice_event"."target"->>'verseRef' ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9 ]+ [1-9][0-9]*:[1-9][0-9]*$')
    or ("practice_event"."target"->>'type' = 'service-unit'
      and "practice_event"."target" ?& array['type','catalogId','catalogIdentity','planId','planRevision','unitId']
      and "practice_event"."target" - array['type','catalogId','catalogIdentity','planId','planRevision','unitId']::text[] = '{}'::jsonb
      and "practice_event"."target"->>'catalogId' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$'
      and "practice_event"."target"->>'planId' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$'
      and jsonb_typeof("practice_event"."target"->'catalogIdentity') = 'string' and "practice_event"."target"->>'catalogIdentity' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
      and jsonb_typeof("practice_event"."target"->'planRevision') = 'number' and "practice_event"."target"->>'planRevision' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$' and "practice_event"."target"->'planRevision' <= '2147483646'::jsonb
      and jsonb_typeof("practice_event"."target"->'unitId') = 'string' and length("practice_event"."target"->>'unitId') between 1 and 128)
  ), false)

student_recording_media.name: student_recording_media
student_recording_media.value: "student_recording"."media_type" in ('audio/webm;codecs=opus','audio/mp4;codecs=mp4a.40.2') and "student_recording"."byte_length" between 1 and 33554432 and "student_recording"."duration_ms" between 1 and 600000

student_recording_instants.name: student_recording_instants
student_recording_instants.value: isfinite("student_recording"."created_at") and ("student_recording"."submitted_at" is null or (isfinite("student_recording"."submitted_at") and "student_recording"."submitted_at" >= "student_recording"."created_at")) and ("student_recording"."deletion_requested_at" is null or (isfinite("student_recording"."deletion_requested_at") and "student_recording"."deletion_requested_at" >= coalesce("student_recording"."submitted_at", "student_recording"."created_at")))

student_recording_lifecycle.name: student_recording_lifecycle
student_recording_lifecycle.value: ("student_recording"."state" = 'private' and "student_recording"."revision" = 1 and "student_recording"."submitted_at" is null and "student_recording"."deletion_requested_at" is null) or ("student_recording"."state" = 'submitted' and "student_recording"."revision" = 2 and "student_recording"."submitted_at" is not null and "student_recording"."deletion_requested_at" is null) or ("student_recording"."state" = 'deleting' and "student_recording"."deletion_requested_at" is not null and (("student_recording"."revision" = 2 and "student_recording"."submitted_at" is null) or ("student_recording"."revision" = 3 and "student_recording"."submitted_at" is not null)))

service_request_bound.name: service_request_bound
service_request_bound.value: length("service_part_request"."row_id") between 1 and 128 and length("service_part_request"."message") between 1 and 2000 and length("service_part_request"."response") <= 2000 and "service_part_request"."revision" > 0

service_part_material_shape.name: service_part_material_shape
service_part_material_shape.value: ("student_service_part"."catalog_id" is null and "student_service_part"."catalog_identity" is null and "student_service_part"."catalog_unit_id" is null) or ("student_service_part"."catalog_id" is not null and "student_service_part"."catalog_identity" is not null and "student_service_part"."catalog_unit_id" is not null and length("student_service_part"."catalog_unit_id") between 1 and 128)

service_part_bound.name: service_part_bound
service_part_bound.value: length("student_service_part"."row_id") between 1 and 128 and length("student_service_part"."directions") <= 4000 and length("student_service_part"."private_feedback") <= 4000 and "student_service_part"."revision" > 0

student_service_plan_selection.name: student_service_plan_selection
student_service_plan_selection.value:
cardinality("student_service_plan"."selected_ids") <= 256 and
    (cardinality("student_service_plan"."selected_ids") = 0 or (array_ndims("student_service_plan"."selected_ids") = 1 and array_lower("student_service_plan"."selected_ids",1) = 1))
    and array_position("student_service_plan"."selected_ids", null) is null and octet_length(array_to_string("student_service_plan"."selected_ids", '|')) <= 16384

verse_source_assignment_versions.name: verse_source_assignment_versions
verse_source_assignment_versions.value: "verse_source_assignment"."version" > 0 and "verse_source_assignment"."base_version" >= 0 and "verse_source_assignment"."version"::bigint = "verse_source_assignment"."base_version"::bigint + 1 and "verse_source_assignment"."assignment_revision" > 0 and (("verse_source_assignment"."base_version"=0 and "verse_source_assignment"."previous_version" is null) or ("verse_source_assignment"."base_version">0 and "verse_source_assignment"."previous_version" is not null and "verse_source_assignment"."previous_version"="verse_source_assignment"."base_version"))

translation_draft_mode.name: translation_draft_mode
translation_draft_mode.value: ("translation_draft"."mode" = 'student' and "translation_draft"."role" = 'student' and "translation_draft"."student_identity_id" is not null and "translation_draft"."guardian_id" is null and "translation_draft"."context_id" is null) or ("translation_draft"."mode" = 'child-practice' and "translation_draft"."role" = 'parent' and "translation_draft"."guardian_id" is not null and "translation_draft"."context_id" is not null and "translation_draft"."student_identity_id" is null)

tutor_note_mode.name: tutor_note_mode
tutor_note_mode.value: "tutor_note"."mode"::text = "tutor_note"."role"::text and "tutor_note"."mode" in ('admin','tutor') and "tutor_note"."guardian_id" is null and "tutor_note"."context_id" is null and "tutor_note"."student_identity_id" is null and length(trim("tutor_note"."text")) > 0

sefaria_text_cache_namespace.name: sefaria_text_cache_namespace
sefaria_text_cache_namespace.value:
"sefaria_text_cache"."provider" = 'sefaria' and "sefaria_text_cache"."api_version" = 'v3'
    and "sefaria_text_cache"."parser_version" = 'parse5-8.0.1' and "sefaria_text_cache"."policy_version" = 'study-normalized-v1'
    and "sefaria_text_cache"."hebrew_edition" = 'mam' and "sefaria_text_cache"."hebrew_language" = 'he'
    and "sefaria_text_cache"."translation_edition" = 'jps2023' and "sefaria_text_cache"."translation_language" = 'en'

sefaria_text_cache_chapter.name: sefaria_text_cache_chapter
sefaria_text_cache_chapter.value: "sefaria_text_cache"."chapter" between 1 and case "sefaria_text_cache"."book" when 'Genesis' then 50 when 'Exodus' then 40 when 'Leviticus' then 27 when 'Numbers' then 36 when 'Deuteronomy' then 34 when 'Joshua' then 24 when 'Judges' then 21 when 'I Samuel' then 31 when 'II Samuel' then 24 when 'I Kings' then 22 when 'II Kings' then 25 when 'Isaiah' then 66 when 'Jeremiah' then 52 when 'Ezekiel' then 48 when 'Hosea' then 14 when 'Joel' then 4 when 'Amos' then 9 when 'Obadiah' then 1 when 'Jonah' then 4 when 'Micah' then 7 when 'Nahum' then 3 when 'Habakkuk' then 3 when 'Zephaniah' then 3 when 'Haggai' then 2 when 'Zechariah' then 14 when 'Malachi' then 3 when 'Psalms' then 150 when 'Proverbs' then 31 when 'Job' then 42 when 'Song of Songs' then 8 when 'Ruth' then 4 when 'Lamentations' then 5 when 'Ecclesiastes' then 12 when 'Esther' then 10 when 'Daniel' then 12 when 'Ezra' then 10 when 'Nehemiah' then 13 when 'I Chronicles' then 29 when 'II Chronicles' then 36 else 0 end

sefaria_text_cache_payload.name: sefaria_text_cache_payload
sefaria_text_cache_payload.value:
jsonb_typeof("sefaria_text_cache"."payload") = 'object'
    and "sefaria_text_cache"."payload" ?& array['verses','editions'] and ("sefaria_text_cache"."payload" - 'verses' - 'editions') = '{}'::jsonb
    and jsonb_typeof("sefaria_text_cache"."payload"->'verses') = 'array' and jsonb_typeof("sefaria_text_cache"."payload"->'editions') = 'array'
    and jsonb_array_length("sefaria_text_cache"."payload"->'verses') between 1 and 176
    and jsonb_array_length("sefaria_text_cache"."payload"->'editions') between 1 and 2
    and octet_length("sefaria_text_cache"."payload"::text) <= 524288

sefaria_text_cache_times.name: sefaria_text_cache_times
sefaria_text_cache_times.value:
isfinite("sefaria_text_cache"."fetched_at") and isfinite("sefaria_text_cache"."expires_at")
    and extract(epoch from "sefaria_text_cache"."fetched_at") >= 0 and extract(epoch from "sefaria_text_cache"."expires_at") <= 8640000000000
    and extract(epoch from "sefaria_text_cache"."fetched_at") * 1000 = trunc(extract(epoch from "sefaria_text_cache"."fetched_at") * 1000)
    and "sefaria_text_cache"."expires_at" = "sefaria_text_cache"."fetched_at" + interval '24 hours'

assignment_aliyah_starts_shape.name: assignment_aliyah_starts_shape
assignment_aliyah_starts_shape.value: "assignment"."aliyah_starts" is null or ("assignment"."kind" = 'torah' and cardinality("assignment"."aliyah_starts") <= 999 and (cardinality("assignment"."aliyah_starts") = 0 or (array_ndims("assignment"."aliyah_starts") = 1 and array_lower("assignment"."aliyah_starts", 1) = 1)) and array_position("assignment"."aliyah_starts", null) is null)

invite_role_target.name: invite_role_target
invite_role_target.value: ("invite"."role" in ('parent', 'student') and "invite"."student_id" is not null) or ("invite"."role" = 'tutor' and "invite"."student_id" is null)

invite_not_accepted_revoked.name: invite_not_accepted_revoked
invite_not_accepted_revoked.value: not ("invite"."accepted_at" is not null and "invite"."revoked_at" is not null)

invite_delivery_shape.name: invite_delivery_shape
invite_delivery_shape.value: ("invite"."delivery_status" = 'pending' and "invite"."delivery_attempted_at" is null) or ("invite"."delivery_status" in ('sent','failed') and "invite"."delivery_attempted_at" is not null)

context_mode_shape.name: context_mode_shape
context_mode_shape.value:
(
    ("practice_context"."mode" = 'child-practice' and "practice_context"."role" = 'parent' and "practice_context"."acting_student_id" is not null and "practice_context"."guardian_id" is not null and "practice_context"."student_identity_id" is null)
    or ("practice_context"."mode" = 'student' and "practice_context"."role" = 'student' and "practice_context"."acting_student_id" is not null and "practice_context"."guardian_id" is null and "practice_context"."student_identity_id" is not null)
    or ("practice_context"."mode"::text = "practice_context"."role"::text and "practice_context"."mode" in ('admin', 'tutor', 'parent') and "practice_context"."acting_student_id" is null and "practice_context"."guardian_id" is null and "practice_context"."student_identity_id" is null)
  )

student_contacts_required.name: student_contacts_required
student_contacts_required.value: ("student"."parent_email" is null or length(trim("student"."parent_email")) > 0) and ("student"."own_email" is null or length(trim("student"."own_email")) > 0) and (("student"."student_kind" = 'child' and "student"."parent_email" is not null) or ("student"."student_kind" = 'adult' and "student"."own_email" is not null))

student_import_metadata_closed.name: student_import_metadata_closed
student_import_metadata_closed.value:
"student"."import_metadata" is null or coalesce(
    jsonb_typeof("student"."import_metadata") = 'object' and "student"."import_metadata"->'version' = '1'::jsonb
    and "student"."import_metadata" ?& array['version','parent1Name','householdPhone','parent2Name','parashahLabel','tutorName','tutorMatch','adminNotes']
    and "student"."import_metadata" - array['version','parent1Name','householdPhone','parent2Name','parashahLabel','tutorName','tutorMatch','adminNotes']::text[] = '{}'::jsonb
    and ("student"."import_metadata"->'parent1Name' = 'null'::jsonb or (jsonb_typeof("student"."import_metadata"->'parent1Name') = 'string' and octet_length("student"."import_metadata"->>'parent1Name') <= 400))
    and ("student"."import_metadata"->'householdPhone' = 'null'::jsonb or (jsonb_typeof("student"."import_metadata"->'householdPhone') = 'string' and octet_length("student"."import_metadata"->>'householdPhone') <= 100))
    and ("student"."import_metadata"->'parent2Name' = 'null'::jsonb or (jsonb_typeof("student"."import_metadata"->'parent2Name') = 'string' and octet_length("student"."import_metadata"->>'parent2Name') <= 400))
    and ("student"."import_metadata"->'parashahLabel' = 'null'::jsonb or (jsonb_typeof("student"."import_metadata"->'parashahLabel') = 'string' and octet_length("student"."import_metadata"->>'parashahLabel') <= 400))
    and ("student"."import_metadata"->'tutorName' = 'null'::jsonb or (jsonb_typeof("student"."import_metadata"->'tutorName') = 'string' and octet_length("student"."import_metadata"->>'tutorName') <= 400))
    and ("student"."import_metadata"->'adminNotes' = 'null'::jsonb or (jsonb_typeof("student"."import_metadata"->'adminNotes') = 'string' and octet_length("student"."import_metadata"->>'adminNotes') <= 4096))
    and ("student"."import_metadata"->'tutorMatch' = 'null'::jsonb or (jsonb_typeof("student"."import_metadata"->'tutorMatch') = 'object' and (
      ("student"."import_metadata"->'tutorMatch'->>'status' = 'matched' and "student"."import_metadata"->'tutorMatch' ? 'grantId'
        and ("student"."import_metadata"->'tutorMatch') - array['status','grantId']::text[] = '{}'::jsonb
        and "student"."import_metadata"->'tutorMatch'->>'grantId' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
      or ("student"."import_metadata"->'tutorMatch'->>'status' in ('unmatched','ambiguous') and ("student"."import_metadata"->'tutorMatch') - 'status' = '{}'::jsonb)
    ))), false)
